segments.sn17.37:1.2: “dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
segments.sn17.37:1.3: Idhāhaṃ, bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi –
segments.sn17.37:1.5: Tamenaṃ passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ.
segments.sn17.37:1.6: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
segments.sn17.37:1.9: Na ca no uppanno lābhasakkārasiloko cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī’ti.

lines: Sattame mātupi hetūti “sace musā bhaṇasi, mātaraṃ te vissajjessāma.
No ce bhaṇasi, na vissajjessāmā”ti evaṃ corehi aṭaviyaṃ pucchamāno tassā corahatthagatāya mātuyāpi hetu sampajānamusā na bhāseyyāti attho.
